description: This file defines the SocketSchedulers class, which manages a collection of PipeScheduler instances for network socket operations, selecting them based on configuration options.

classes.name: SocketSchedulers
classes.description: Manages a set of PipeScheduler instances for handling socket IO operations, supporting configurable number of schedulers.

methods.name: SocketSchedulers
methods.description: Constructor that initializes schedulers based on provided options, either using a specified IO queue count or default thread pool schedulers.

methods.name: GetScheduler
methods.description: Returns the next PipeScheduler in a round-robin manner for scheduling socket-related work.
